course_description:
Private Equity and Venture Capital places emphasis on cash flow modelling of potential/actual portfolio company investments, fund level performance, understanding addressable markets and the power rule. The course explores business model viability and technological feasibility in detail using appropriate methodologies covering market and illiquidity risks.

Private Equity and Venture Capital places an emphasis on cash flow modelling of potential/actual portfolio company investments, fund level performance, understanding addressable markets and the power rule. The course explores business model viability and technological feasibility in detail using appropriate methodologies covering market and illiquidity risks. To enhances employability skills through scenario-based learning , students integrate technical financial capability with communication, teamwork, and reflective skills aligned to professional investment and advisory roles. Working in teams they will develop complex analysis, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills presenting investment recommendations to an industry panel whilst reflecting on processes, decision-making outcomes and evaluating performance for future practice.

Course Changes in Response to Previous Student Feedback

An additional Online Quiz has been added to provide early feedback for the online content.

course_aims: This course aims to give students a deeper understanding of the distinct characteristics of private equity, private credit, and venture capital investments. Students will be expected to understand the motivations and compensation mechanisms commonly utilised in the sector.

learning_outcomes.description: Integrate financial and non-financial data from multiple sources to make robust investment decisions.
Analyse return streams on the various stages of a private business/venture evolution over different investment horizons to maximise returns on exit.
Present conclusions, key valuation strategies and findings to stakeholders with a group of peers.
Evaluate technological feasibility and business model viability.
Customise incentive frameworks appropriate for different stakeholders within the investment model.
